name: qonto
description: Agent Skills for business banking and financial tools on Qonto. Featured plugins are built by Qonto, community plugins are reviewed by Qonto before they ship.

plugins.name: argentier
plugins.description: Finds the money a business can stop spending: true recurring run-rate, duplicate tools, ghost and new subscriptions, price increases and FX fees, with a ranked savings plan, cheaper alternatives and cancellation messages. Read-only.

plugins.name: argentier-btp
plugins.description: Quote-to-cash for French building trades: compliant quotes (VAT 20, 10, 5.5 percent or reverse charge, ten-year insurance mention), then deposit, progress and final invoices linked to the quote, retention tracking and payment links. Nothing is sent: quotes unsent, invoices as drafts, each confirmed by the user.

plugins.name: argentier-cash-forecast
plugins.description: 13-week cash forecast built client by client: real payment delays, recurring flows learned from history, base, stress and upside scenarios, lowest week, actions to take, and a 12-month outlook. Read-only.

plugins.name: argentier-founder-pay
plugins.description: Tells a founder how much the business can afford to pay them this month and next quarter, after commitments, tax provisions and a safety buffer, and compares the ways to take it by legal form (France). Read-only.
